scope: Source evidence distinguishes renderer features, simulation LOD and absent presentation systems. Source tracing alone is not a visual pass.

systems.finding: merged_model bakes GLB transforms, merges surfaces by material, generates ImporterMesh LODs (25/60) and caches meshes. Cars and trains use these meshes at all opaque-view distances. Runtime default-threshold perspective sweeps sample actual draw primitive changes.

Absent in current opaque renderer: train always calls place_model_car for locomotive/coach and returns. godot/assets/vehicles/SOURCES.md distant-procedural wording is stale; production asset documentation was deliberately left unchanged. Tests test_car_model_has_no_range_limit and test_vehicle_models_at_distance corroborate the live path.

Near batches visibility_range_end=400; far batches visibility_range_begin=400, shadows disabled on far batches. Runtime captures straddle 399.9/400.1 m with constant apparent size for diagnostic comparison; perspective scene integration is separate.
Live selector chooses detail 0 above 40 m, 1 at or below. Imported animal geometry may remain identical across keys. Runtime uses actual helper.person/animal calls, not fixed detail arguments.

Fallback car path changes detail beyond 35 m only when opaque=false; opaque standard gameplay uses merged imported car meshes and live detail meshes. Runtime manifest samples all eight legacy shapes at 34.9/35.1 m, alongside all 20 registered imported vehicle GLBs at six distances.

Pedestrian/resident distance tiers at 500/1500 m choose update cadence; NPC lod_level is simulation state. These do not themselves select GLB geometry LOD. Entity-layer visibility filtering and view bounds may omit far entities, distinct from GPU mesh simplification.

Production material default CULL_BACK; depth testing is normal shaded rendering. Common MapLayer inserts chunk meshes into one Buildings3D layer and removes them on free_chunk. Search over all Godot scripts/scenes/project settings for OccluderInstance3D/occlusion_culling found no configured software occlusion system (only a descriptive comment). Passing mapped street/bridge/walking screenshots show representative depth overlap, not per-type natural placement/culling certification.

3D interior emits floors, wall prisms and door lintels/collision only. Furniture is the separate 2D PlanCanvas renderer. No 3D ceiling/windows/furniture or indoor day/night lighting controller is created. The actual indoor viewport has fixed ambient energy .75 plus one directional light at (-60,-30,0). Room traversal tests this implemented lighting, not absent variants. Room labels such as stairs do not create 3D stair geometry.

Actual GPUParticles3D shader renders rain/slush streaks or snow quads; fixed 6800 particles (85% intensity), deterministic seed 1, wind 0/12 m/s and production house roof/height-field collision are captured. This supplements existing 2D fallback weather evidence.
At the exact ready source pose, live chunk road metadata is [137,129,112], surface_texture 5: mapped gravel, not asphalt hidden by terrain. Screenshot_start.png shows the expected tan textured road.

500 m chunks, load radius 3, unload radius 4. Ready audit drive traveled 525.27 m and loaded seven new chunks; zero removals, so it observes natural load/depth continuity but does not certify eviction/reload. The subsequent natural 220 s excursion/revisit below additionally observes 14 evictions and seven same-ID reloads.

White unshaded snow appears in the isolated production-renderer fixture but is not discernible in ready 1280x720 gameplay city day/night or dark-forest eye views. The latter reports 5600 emitting particles and differing frames 2 s apart; whole-frame differences are not proof of flake visibility. VQA-038 records appearance, no root cause inferred.

An ordinary-input 220 s excursion on the existing sourced Utajärvi pose produced 14 natural server evictions and seven same-ID reloads, observed in 221 snapshots while production map/weather/camera readiness stayed clear. Maximum excursion 1199.21 m, final distance 102.82 m from start. Audit runner reverses along sampled driver positions; production code is unchanged. Start/turn/end screenshots inspected; the path leaves the road so no driving legality or lane-following claim.
